profile.headline: Bolt Graphics, Ex-Google, Ex-Adobe, Ex-Mojo Vision, Ex-VSCO, Ex-MetaCreations -- Developer specializing in Computer Graphics

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Software development and design, primarily related to Computer Graphics, in support of Bolt Graphics solutions.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Graphics
positions.description:
Web Studio Rendering Engine
- WebGL2 rendering for photo editing (GLSL & Typescript)
- WebAssembly with C++, Rust and WebGPU
- Rendering for color manipulation and tools

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
- Python bindings for Mojo Graphics Engine (C++, using pybind11)
- Animated Bezier curves for UI
- IPC (Inter-Process Communication) between C++ engine and Dart/Flutter
- Syncing with Blender 3D for live 3D views or our system
- AR Contact Lens simulator using Unity 3D (VR with Eye Tracking)
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Dart · Flutter · Language Bindings · Augmented Reality (AR)

positions.title: Independent Researcher and Developer (I R&D)
positions.description: I am currently involved in developing multiple projects, related to a personal knowledge network, handwritten UI, Android development, graphics rendering, audio signal analysis, stock charting (beyond candles) and natural intelligence.
